name: routines
title: Routines
description: Run a prompt in a workspace on a schedule you set: weekdays, every day, chosen days, every few hours, or a cron line. Each routine names a profile, what the agent should do and what you want to see when it ends. When one is due, Mirador starts a fresh conversation for it, which works on its own and then waits for you in the sidebar like any other. The workspace's Routines tab lists them with when they next run, edits them, starts one now, and keeps the recent runs.
tagline: Run a prompt in a workspace on a schedule, each run a conversation of its own.
